verdict.rationale: Fellow's own Developer API returns notes, transcripts, recordings metadata and action items over standard REST with cursor pagination. Note content comes as Fellow Markdown, which is GitHub-Flavored Markdown plus extensions. The Super Admin API explicitly supports retrieving, exporting and deleting workspace data for backup, but only on the Enterprise plan, and the API needs a paid plan with admin enablement. Missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk full-account export, evidence that recordings' audio/video media can be exported, export for non-Enterprise individual users, a documented account-deletion/offboarding path, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: The Developer API opens that data to you: transcripts, structured notes, and more, all available through standard REST calls.

Fellow’s Super Admin API lets designated Enterprise‑plan administrators retrieve, export, and delete data across the entire workspace, making it simple to back up notes and transcripts for legal purposes
Fellow Markdown is the format the API uses for reading and writing note content. It is GitHub-Flavored Markdown plus Fellow extensions
Each Recording is associated with a Note, and can contain information such as: Diarized and timestamped transcripts
The Fellow Developer API uses cursor-based pagination for all list endpoints.
